overview_description.description: Our goal is to change the face of payments, banking, and to make payment processing stupid... sorry we meant simple. So simple in fact that you’ll never waste your precious time yelling at customer support ever again. You can instead spend that time flexing on your competitors, customers, parents, friends, dog...and with how good our technology is, maybe even the aliens.

product.name: Online Payments
product.description: A payment gateway for accepting card, digital wallet, and local payment transactions through websites, mobile apps, and hosted or embedded checkout experiences.

product.name: Recurring Payments
product.description: A billing service for automatically collecting scheduled payments for subscriptions, memberships, installment plans, and other repeat-charge business models.

product.name: Payment Links
product.description: A no-code tool for creating shareable payment URLs that let customers make one-time or variable payments through cards and supported digital payment methods.

product.name: Dibsy Dashboard
product.description: A centralized web-based interface for monitoring transactions, processing refunds, analyzing payment performance, and managing merchant accounts and team access.

product.name: Payment APIs and Developer Integrations
product.description: API, SDK, plugin, documentation, and sandbox tools for integrating Dibsy payment acceptance into websites, mobile applications, e-commerce platforms, and business systems.
